summary: Completed testing of Arabic ERP system fixes: 1) Activation Code payment amount=0 (free gift), 2) Email templates render dynamic data correctly, 3) hr_admin and hr_financial appear in permissions list, 4) Sidebar has no duplicate tabs. All 7 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/permissions correctly returns hr_admin and hr_financial with Arabic labels
PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/permissions accepts hr_admin and hr_financial in valid_permission_ids
GET /api/admin/payments/methods returns activation_code method with Arabic label 'كود تفعيل'
PUT /api/admin/payments/subscriptions/{id}/payment correctly sets amount=0 when payment_method=activation_code
Frontend payment modal auto-sets amount to 0 and disables the field when activation_code is selected
Frontend shows helper text 'كود التفعيل = هدية مجانية (المبلغ = 0)' for activation_code
Sidebar tabs are unique - no duplicate 'المدفوعات' or 'المعاملات' tabs
Email templates use f-strings with proper dynamic data rendering and None filtering in _create_data_table
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested fixes verified: 1) Activation Code payment sets amount=0 (free gift) - backend enforces this in admin_payments.py line 153-154, frontend auto-sets and disables amount field. 2) Email templates in professional_email_service.py correctly render dynamic data using f-strings with None filtering. 3) hr_admin and hr_financial permissions are in admin.py ALL_PERMISSIONS list (line 1166-1167) and valid_permission_ids (line 1322). 4) Sidebar tabs are unique - Payments (المدفوعات) and Transactions (المعاملات) are separate tabs.

permissions_api.details: GET /api/admin/permissions returns hr_admin (إدارة الموارد البشرية) and hr_financial (مالية الموارد البشرية)
